summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) set and cleared in run's run_app coroutine. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 10 tests; all pass (10/10) on Python 3.9 when PYTHONPATH points at the repo's src/, because the venv's textual resolves to a separate base/ tree. Pre-existing async-test failures in test_unmount.py and test_message_pump.py come from the missing async pytest plugin in the venv and are unrelated. Nothing committed. Python 3.7 not verified.
